FRAMEWORK · qeva:1:first-order-logic@1

First-order logic

First-order logic quantifies over objects while keeping predicates and functions in a fixed signature.

editoriallogic · foundations
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

First-order logic quantifies over objects while keeping predicates and functions in a fixed signature.

EXACT

The compact statement

An FOL presentation declares terms, formulas, variable binding, equality if used, a proof calculus, and Tarskian semantics for structures.

Example

Group theory can be axiomatized in a first-order language with multiplication, identity, and inverse.

Boundary / caveat

FOL is one highly successful framework, not the unique language of mathematics.

Assumptions

  • The declared formal logic context is fixed.
